title: How Do MNEs and Domestic Firms Respond Locally to a Global Demand Shock? Evidence from a Pandemic
eligible_reason: Single shock date: Post = months from April 2009 (H1N1 pandemic). Treated = influenza vaccine market versus other vaccine markets. Two-group, one-date DiD with market and region FE, season dummies, and a post main effect. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: Market-region-month panel of Indian vaccine sales (AIOCD), April 2007-March 2011, 23 regions. table2.do: reghdfe mneshare post_treated post i.season, absorb(market region) vce(cluster market region); subsamples by economic/infrastructure lag and political alignment; Table 4 triple interactions with continuous region characteristics; Table 6 adds afterpost; Table 7 firm-level ppmlhdfe.
